text:
zoe: quick flag — found multiple stale links in docs/error-ref/429.md that point to the old SDK retry header. snippet uses `X-Retry-After` and references v1 SDK. need a PR to replace with the unified SDK retry wrapper + new example.

zoe: ```js
// old snippet
fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'X-Retry-After': '120' } })
```

devin: thanks — can take this. i'll fork and open a PR. do we have a canonical snippet in `sdk-examples`? :eyes:

maya: there's `sdk-examples/retries.js` in the repo but it's out of date. +1 to pinning example to `@redwood/sdk@^2.0.0`. also add a short migration note for v1 -> v2 retry semantics.

noah: heads-up — this update should include guidance for 429 vs 503 fallback behavior and a recommended jitter/backoff table. see runbook v2: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rate-limits (internal).

zoe: PR checklist idea: update snippet, replace link, add migration note, run markdown linter, add a tiny test that example builds (docs-ci). assign to @maya for final content review.

devin: ETA today EOD. will raise a draft PR with title: "replace legacy retry header, add backoff example and migration note".

docs-bot: docs-ci triggered for PR # (draft) — 1/3 checks started. markdown-lint flagged a long line in the migration note.

maya: i can finish lint fix and do content review tomorrow AM. also please add a short note about context-window implications when trimming prompts (clients may need to shorten system messages first).

zoe: good call. add inline code comment: // prefer server-side header management; client should use SDK's retry wrapper

noah: also update the streaming section — add a short line on stream interrupt behavior when retries kick in and link to StreamInterrupts section.

devin: pushed changes to branch and opened draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 — PTAL. includes updated snippet using `sdk.retry.withJitter()` and backoff table.

maya: reviewing now. :thumbsup: will leave inline comments and merge once docs-ci turns green.

docs-bot: docs-ci passed. spellcheck: 0 warnings. linkcheck: detected one external dead link: https://old.vendor/retries -> mark for replacement.

zoe: capturing action items: (1) swap header to SDK wrapper, (2) add recommended backoff jitter sample, (3) add migration note re: context trimming and prompt ordering, (4) replace external dead link with partner or archived copy. assigning noah for (4).

noah: ack — i'll contact partner and source an updated link or request permission to host an archived copy.

maya: merged the PR and updated changelog entry. release note: docs v1.14.2 published, included in release-notes channel.

zoe: thanks team. i'll post a quick blurb in #release-notes and close this thread after verification. :rocket:
